specs.label: Audio input signal types
specs.value: 4 stereo analog (RCA); 4 digital S/PDIF (2 TOSLINK and 2 Coaxial); Up to 8 stereo DM NAX or AES67 audio-over-IP streams; Up to 8 stereo cloud-based media streams from streaming service providers

specs.label: Audio output signal types
specs.value: 8 stereo speaker-level amplified outputs; 4 stereo line-level analog outputs (mirroring speaker zone outputs 1-4); Up to 24 stereo DM NAX or AES67 audio-over-IP streams

specs.label: Output Power
specs.value: 150 Watts per channel at 8 Ohms; 300 Watts per channel at 4 Ohms; 500 Watts per channel at 8 Ohms bridged

specs.label: Amplifier Monitoring
specs.value: Over Current, Over/Under Voltage, Over Temperature, DC Offset, Clipping

specs.label: S/N Ratio
specs.value: 110 dB digital in, 108 dB analog in

specs.label: Stereo Separation
specs.value: 85 dB @ 1 kHz, 8 ohm; 80 dB @ 1 kHz, 4 ohm

specs.label: Zone Separation
specs.value: 100 dB @ 1 kHz, 8 ohm; 95 dB @ 1 kHz, 4 ohm

specs.label: Zone Volume Level Control
specs.value: -80.0 to +20.0 dB, adjustable from 0% to 100% plus mute
